opciones.explicacion: Not an enterprise lake.

opciones.texto_opcion: Skip bronze and mutate production gold in place from devices
opciones.explicacion: Corrupts trusted serving data.

opciones.texto_opcion: Force every device to write Dedicated SQL rows directly
opciones.explicacion: Tight coupling and poor scale for bursty IoT.

opciones.texto_opcion: Land raw JSON in a bronze ADLS zone, then curate to Parquet/Delta.
opciones.explicacion: Raw landing preserves source fidelity; curation enforces schema for analytics.

pregunta: A media streaming company (~200 million rows/day, region eastus) must: some legacy apps use Blob REST while analytics needs Hadoop-compatible paths. Which option fits best? Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Two disconnected storage accounts with nightly robocopy, duplication and sync risk.
opciones.explicacion: Duplication and sync risk.

opciones.texto_opcion: Azure CDN as the only data plane, cDN caches content, cDN caches content
opciones.explicacion: CDN caches content; not lake analytics storage.

opciones.texto_opcion: Azure Disks attached to one VM only, not a shared multi-protocol lake.
opciones.explicacion: Not a shared multi-protocol lake.

opciones.texto_opcion: ADLS Gen2 multi-protocol access on one account.
opciones.explicacion: Gen2 supports Blob and DFS endpoints over the same hierarchical data.

pregunta: Logistics carrier scenario — reduce storage and scan cost for large fact extracts written daily. What should they implement? Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Base64-encode Parquet inside CSV, adds overhead without benefit.
opciones.explicacion: Adds overhead without benefit.

opciones.texto_opcion: Store uncompressed fixed-width text forever, inflates cost and scan time.
opciones.explicacion: Inflates cost and scan time.

opciones.texto_opcion: ZIP each row into individual blobs, tiny-object overhead; poor analytics.
opciones.explicacion: Tiny-object overhead; poor analytics.

opciones.texto_opcion: Write Snappy/ZSTD-compressed Parquet with sensible.
opciones.explicacion: Compressed columnar files cut storage and I/O for analytical engines.

pregunta: Incident review (australiaeast): serverless SQL should query ADLS without ingesting into Dedicated pool. Select the most appropriate design. Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: BCP into tempdb on a VM only, not serverless lake SQL.
opciones.explicacion: Not serverless lake SQL.

opciones.texto_opcion: Publish to anonymous FTP as the default production choice here.
opciones.explicacion: Insecure.

opciones.texto_opcion: Create external table / OPENROWSET over ADLS files.
opciones.explicacion: External tables enable lake queries without Dedicated storage.

opciones.texto_opcion: Access via RDP to a desktop CSV adopted as the standard.
opciones.explicacion: Not enterprise.

pregunta: Incident review (australiaeast): new lake must support HNS, lifecycle, and analytics workloads from day one. Select the most appropriate design. Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Create StorageV2 account and enable hierarchical namespace.
opciones.explicacion: ADLS Gen2 is StorageV2 with HNS enabled—the standard analytics lake foundation.

opciones.texto_opcion: Azure NetApp Files as the only analytics lake
opciones.explicacion: ANF is NFS/SMB performance storage, not typical Spark lake.

opciones.texto_opcion: Azure File Sync cloud tiering as the lake, file sync is for SMB shares.
opciones.explicacion: File sync is for SMB shares.

opciones.texto_opcion: Legacy Blob Storage only without upgrade path planning, missing modern lake features.
opciones.explicacion: Missing modern lake features.
